title: Fix MeetingPresencesRepository.getAllAsync 404 handling — return Failure, not getByMeetingId(0)
objective: Make MeetingPresencesRepository.getAllAsync() return a Failure(ApiError.notFound) (or UnimplementedError if the backend does not expose a list-all endpoint), instead of the current silent call to getByMeetingId(0) which would return either an empty list or — worse — a 500 because meetingId=0 does not exist.
description: MeetingPresencesRepository.getAllAsync (lib/data/repositories/meetingPresences/meeting_presences_repository.dart, lines 27-30) currently calls `meetingPresencesApiClient.getByMeetingId(0)`. After H3 deletes RepositoryBase / IRepositoryBase, this method may no longer satisfy the interface (if it inherited from IRepositoryBase). The fix has two acceptable shapes: (a) if the backend exposes GET /MeetingPresences (a real list-all endpoint), implement it directly via a new API client method; (b) otherwise return Failure(ApiError(type: ApiErrorType.notFound, userMessage: ErrorMessages.notFound)) — or throw UnimplementedError('No list-all endpoint for MeetingPresences; use getByMeetingId instead') returned as a Failure. Either way, the method MUST NOT call getByMeetingId(0) — that is a sentinel value that produces undefined backend behaviour.

reference_files.reason: After H3, this interface may need to drop `implements IRepositoryBase<MeetingPresencesEntity>`. Update if so.
Source for adding a real list-all endpoint if the backend exposes one. Otherwise this file is read-only context.
Inspect /MeetingPresences paths to decide between fix shape (a) and (b).

fix_shape.shape_a_backend_has_list_all: Add IMeetingPresencesApiClient.getAllAsync() that calls GET $_basePath with the same 200/404 handling as getByMeetingId; call it from the repository's getAllAsync.
fix_shape.shape_b_backend_has_no_list_all: Return Failure(Exception('MeetingPresencesRepository.getAllAsync is not implemented; use getByMeetingId(meetingId) instead')) with a `// TODO(backend): GET /MeetingPresences` comment above the method.

acceptance_criteria: Either the method dispatches GET /MeetingPresences (shape a) or it returns Failure with a clear UnimplementedError-style message + TODO(backend) comment (shape b)
The repository's other methods (getByMeetingId, createAsync, deleteAsync, deleteByIdAsync) are unchanged
If H3 dropped IRepositoryBase from the interface, the getAllAsync signature here matches whatever the new interface declares — typically `AsyncResult<List<MeetingPresencesEntity>> getAllAsync()`
flutter analyze lib/data/repositories/meetingPresences/ returns no errors

grep_evidence: rg -n 'getByMeetingId\(0\)' lib/ must return zero matches
rg -n 'TODO\(backend\): GET /MeetingPresences' lib/data/repositories/meetingPresences/meeting_presences_repository.dart must return at least one match if shape (b) is chosen

no_op_outside_scope: Do not touch getByMeetingId / createAsync / deleteAsync / deleteByIdAsync on MeetingPresencesRepository. Do not touch any other repository. The dependency on H3 means this subtask cannot start until H3 lands.
